response.rationale: All options map to the same leaf 'Rectal Ulcer' with the same relation type and support scores. Therefore, the ranking is based on the specificity and clinical accuracy of the terms. 'Radiation-induced rectal ulcer (radiation proctopathy)' (C) is the most comprehensive and accurate description given the vignette. 'Radiation-induced solitary rectal ulcer' (A) is also very good but slightly less comprehensive than C. 'Radiation-induced proctitis with ulceration' (D) is a reasonable description but 'proctitis' might imply more diffuse inflammation than the 'solitary ulcer' described. 'Solitary rectal ulcer syndrome' (B) is a distinct condition often associated with defecatory disorders and is less likely given the clear history of radiation therapy, making it the least likely among the matched options.
